summary: Member Profiles and User Approval feature testing completed successfully. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend verification confirmed all features working: profile page with 4 editable sections, profile photo upload, registration with Staff/Cadre role selection, admin page with 3 tabs (Pending Approval, All Users, Settings), Find Matches for roster linking, and Direct Approve functionality.
passed_tests: Backend - POST /api/auth/login works with commander credentials
Backend - GET /api/profile returns user profile with all fields
Backend - PUT /api/profile updates basic info (phone, cell_phone)
Backend - PUT /api/profile updates CAP info (rank, unit, wing, region)
Backend - PUT /api/profile updates address (address, city, state, zip)
Backend - PUT /api/profile updates emergency contact
Backend - PUT /api/profile cannot change user's own role
Backend - POST /api/auth/register with staff role creates is_approved=false user
Backend - POST /api/auth/register with cadet role creates is_approved=false user
Backend - POST /api/auth/register with invalid role (commander) defaults to staff
Backend - GET /api/users/pending returns pending users list
Backend - POST /api/users/{id}/approve approves user with approved_by and approved_at
Backend - POST /api/users/{id}/approve returns 404 for non-existent user
Backend - GET /api/users/pending requires commander role (403 for non-commander)
Backend - GET /api/users/{id}/match-participants finds potential matches by CAPID/email/name
Backend - POST /api/users/{id}/link-participant links user to roster participant
Backend - POST /api/users/{id}/link-participant returns 404 for non-existent participant
Backend - POST /api/profile/photo rejects non-image files (400)
Backend - POST /api/profile/photo accepts valid image and returns base64 data URL
Backend - DELETE /api/profile/photo removes profile photo
Frontend - Login page loads with email/password form
Frontend - Registration form shows Full Name, CAP ID, Role selector, Email, Password
Frontend - Role selector has Staff/Senior Member and Cadre/Cadet options
Frontend - New user registration creates account with pending approval
Frontend - Profile page /profile loads with user information
Frontend - Profile page shows 4 sections: Basic Info, CAP Info, Address, Emergency Contact
Frontend - Profile page shows approval status (Approved or Pending Approval)
Frontend - Edit Profile button enables edit mode with input fields
Frontend - Profile edit mode has Save Changes and Cancel buttons
Frontend - Profile photo upload button exists with camera icon
Frontend - Admin page shows 3 tabs: Pending Approval, All Users, Settings
Frontend - Pending Approval tab shows pending users with Find Matches and Approve buttons
Frontend - Find Matches searches roster by CAPID/email/name and shows results
Frontend - 'No matching participants found' shown when no matches exist
Frontend - Direct Approve button approves user immediately
Frontend - 'User approved successfully' toast appears after approval
Frontend - All Users tab shows registered users with role/squadron/flight selectors
Frontend - Settings tab shows Role Permissions and Unit Structure info
seed_data_creation: Test users created and cleaned up during backend pytest run. One additional test user created during UI testing and manually cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Member Profiles feature fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) Profile page (/profile) with 4 editable sections - Basic Info, CAP Info, Address, Emergency Contact. 2) Profile photo upload (5MB limit, base64 storage). 3) Registration form updated with Staff/Cadre role selection. 4) Admin page reorganized with 3 tabs - Pending Approval shows pending users with Find Matches and Approve buttons, All Users shows registered users table with role/squadron/flight management, Settings shows Role Permissions and Unit Structure info. 5) Find Matches searches roster participants by CAPID, email, and name with confidence levels (high/medium). 6) Link & Approve links user to roster participant and auto-populates profile fields. 7) Direct Approve approves user without roster linking. All endpoints require authentication and commander role for admin functions.
